node.title: Budget-three path Mobius transversal
node.statement: Every path-plus-singleton B*=3 split pencil is a coupled pair of constant pencils with injective Mobius-transversal complements. The degree-d pencil has exactly three fully domain-split members for d>=3, and the degree-(d-1) pencil has exactly three for d>=6. The order-eight singular witness is the sharp d=2 four-member exception. A separate d=4 power-of-two witness shows that exact-three does not exclude the path; existence on official rows remains open.
